name: Compressed natural gas and LNG as vehicle fuel
principle: Natural gas is compressed to about 200 bar (CNG) or liquefied (LNG) and used in spark-ignition or dual-fuel engines. The global fleet was 26.2 million vehicles in 2018, mostly in China, Iran, India, Pakistan, Argentina and Brazil.
